/services: Our Services Assessments Do you know something just isn’t right, but aren’t sure what it is? Received a diagnosis somewhere else and want a second opinion? Maybe you have tried treatment after treatment and nothing seems to be working. We offer in-depth assessment and diagnosis to help you understand the challenges you face. (This might include lab tests or other specialized testing.) Treatment Individualized treatment to fit your life and needs. Sometimes it is medications, sometimes it’s therapy, often it is a combination of both. No matter what you are facing, we will develop a treatment plan to get you back to living your best life. Conditions We Treat Addiction and substance use disorders Anxiety ADD and ADHD Bipolar Disorder Depression Insomnia PTSD Schizophrenia and schizoaffective disorders *not all treated disorders are listed here Payment and Insurance We accept several different insurance plans, including some types of Medicaid, United Healthcare, PEHP, DMBA, Regence/BCBS, SelectHealth and University of Utah Health Plans. Please call to verify coverage when you schedule your appointment. For those who don’t have insurance, we do offer self pay rates. New patient consults are 60 -80 minutes in length and are $250. Return visits are 20-30 minutes in length and $185. Both include medication management and brief solution-focused therapy. For those patients who only need medication management and do not have complicated treatment plans, a 15 minute appointment is available for $150. Payment is due at the time at the time of service. We accept cash, credit card, check, and Venmo. Missed appointments or appointments cancelled within 24 hours will be charged a cancellation fee of $200 for new patients, and $100 for return patients. Scheduling Appointments We know you are busy. Schedule in person or virtually; evening and weekend appointments are available.
